scripts.dev:content-service: bash -c 'set -a && source services/.env.local && set +a && cd services/content-service && mvn spring-boot:run'
scripts.dev:session-service: bash -c 'set -a && source services/.env.local && set +a && cd services/session-service && mvn spring-boot:run'
scripts.dev:report-service: bash -c 'set -a && source services/.env.local && set +a && cd services/report-service && mvn spring-boot:run'
scripts.dev:practice-game-service: bash -c 'set -a && source services/.env.local && set +a && cd services/practice-game-service && mvn spring-boot:run'
scripts.dev:ml-analysis: bash -c 'set -a && source backend/.env && set +a && cd services/ml-analysis && ../../backend/venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --port 9002 --reload'
scripts.dev:ml-recommendation: bash -c 'set -a && source backend/.env && set +a && cd services/ml-recommendation && ../../backend/venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --port 9003 --reload'
scripts.predev:all:
bash -c 'if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "
[Cadence] Error: Docker daemon is not running. Please start Docker Desktop and run npm run dev:all again.

" >&2; exit 1; fi && docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml up -d'
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev" "cd backend && venv/bin/python main.py" "npm run dev:content-service" "npm run dev:session-service" "npm run dev:report-service" "npm run dev:practice-game-service" "npm run dev:ml-audio" "npm run dev:ml-analysis" "npm run dev:ml-recommendation"
